root_cause: The Journey/Goals/Forecast cockpit merged to main, while Netlify production still identified the prior main SHA. The canonical Production Source Snapshot transport must be explicitly refreshed for this release lineage.
prevention_rule: A material Portal feature is terminal only when the exact current main SHA is present on Netlify production and production readback verifies the affected Portal routes. Promotion-only candidates must carry learning, ledger and human documentation in the same lineage.

evidence.outcome: Canonical source snapshot promotion binds the Journey/Goals/Forecast cockpit to exact production identity before terminal success.
